title: RobotEvent
description: A single interaction event emitted by the robot or simulator via POST /api/events

session_id.description: ID of the session this event belongs to

robot_id.description: Identifier of the physical robot unit that produced this event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred

trigger.description: What caused this event to be produced

wake_word.description: The wake phrase that was heard. Only populated for wake_word events

command_text.description: The spoken command text. Null for gesture events

response_text.description: What the robot said or did in response to the command

gesture_detected.description: Name of the gesture detected. Null for non-gesture events

language.description: Language code of the spoken command

confidence_score.description: NLP or gesture recognition confidence score. 0 = no confidence, 1 = certain

noise_level.description: Estimated ambient noise level at the time of the event

retry_count.description: Number of times the user had to repeat themselves before the robot understood

processing_latency_ms.description: Time in ms from wake-word detection to command fully parsed. Null for wake_word events

response_latency_ms.description: Time in ms from command parsed to robot physically acting. Null for wake_word events

success.description: Whether the robot successfully understood and executed the command

error_code.description: Reason for failure when success = false. Null when success = true

robot_state.description: What the robot was doing when this event was produced
